verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents a concrete authoring format for skills: a directory with a SKILL.md file containing YAML frontmatter and markdown instructions. It has a dedicated guide to build, test, and publish custom workspace or personal skills, and a skills page covering loading and precedence. The `openclaw skills` CLI explicitly installs skills from local directories, and MCP servers offer another documented way to add your own tools. Missing for 10: a documented authoring format or SDK for code plugins and custom tools (plugin evidence covers installing from ClawHub, not writing them), and independent or hands-on confirmation of the local skill authoring workflow.
